prompt: Users hit an ALB that routes to an EKS cluster in a private subnet, which reads from RDS Postgres and caches in ElastiCache.

Serverless image pipeline: users upload via API Gateway to a Lambda that stores files in S3; S3 events go to SQS, a worker Lambda creates thumbnails and writes metadata to DynamoDB. Logs in CloudWatch.
dsl:
User [icon: user]
AWS [icon: aws-cloud] {
  Api [icon: aws-api-gateway, label: "Upload API"]
  UploadFn [icon: aws-lambda, label: "Upload"]
  Bucket [icon: aws-s3, label: "Images"]
  Queue [icon: aws-sqs, label: "Image events"]
  ThumbFn [icon: aws-lambda, label: "Thumbnailer"]
  Metadata [icon: aws-dynamodb, label: "Metadata"]
  Logs [icon: aws-cloudwatch, label: "Logs"]
}
User > Api: "HTTPS"
Api > UploadFn > Bucket
Bucket > Queue: "ObjectCreated"
Queue > ThumbFn
ThumbFn > Bucket
ThumbFn > Metadata
UploadFn > Logs
ThumbFn > Logs
